$doc: What each line of the world gizmo is drawn in, so the lines and the
shell's legend of them read one color: the frame's marks about the focus
(scene/indicator/frame_gizmo.rs) and the coverage's over the ground
(scene/indicator/coverage_gizmo.rs). Each #rrggbb in sRGB, dashed where a
dashed line draws it: a ring of the frame, a stretch of the coverage.

frame.$doc: About the focus; the rings are dashed.

focus.$doc: The focus and the ground cell it floors to.

forward.$doc: The upright ring facing the screen, and the view's forward on it.

north.$doc: The upright ring through north, and north on it.

coverage.$doc: Over the ground, lowest first: a stretch shared by several is drawn in the last.

drawn_from_floor.$doc: A drawn piece read from the floor's tile alone.

unbuilt.$doc: A goal piece with a tile on its line, its mesh not yet built.

floor_only.$doc: A goal piece only the floor's tile can build.

no_tile.$doc: A goal piece with no tile on its line.

shard.$doc: A drawn piece's shard, the unit the world's data is kept in.
